blocks.orig: Pemba Paradise Lodge is situated on the beautiful Pemba Island on the north-west coast in the village of Makangale. The hotel offers 8 ocean-view suites with a sleeping and a sitting area, and 8 garden-view double rooms, all set in a beautiful garden. The rooms are fitted with one big double bed, whereas the suites come with additional daybeds, which can be used for extra guests – great for small families. They also feature ensuite bathrooms and a private terrace. The restaurant serves delicious meals, all prepared with fresh fish straight out of the ocean and fruits and vegetables from the lodge’s garden or the local market. To top it off, you’ll find a great beach area and a swimming pool here, as well as two bars; the Pili Pili Bar situated next to the restaurant, and the Mapenzi Beach Bar where you can admire the sunset over the ocean.
blocks.html: Pemba Paradise Lodge lies in the village of Makangale on the north-west coast of lovely Pemba Island. The hotel has 8 ocean-view suites, each with a bedroom and a lounge area, and 8 garden-view double rooms, all within a beautiful garden. Each room has one large double bed, while the suites also have daybeds that can sleep extra guests – ideal for small families. All come with an ensuite bathroom and a private terrace. The restaurant serves tasty dishes made with fresh fish caught in the ocean and fruit and vegetables from the lodge’s own garden or the local market. On top of that, there is a lovely beach area and a swimming pool, plus two bars; the Pili Pili Bar beside the restaurant, and the Mapenzi Beach Bar, where you can watch the sun set over the ocean.
